title_sq: Okazion! Tek Condor Center Shitet Dyqan, Mundesi Ideale Per Investim!!
description_sq: Tek Rruga e Kavajes, tek Condor Center, shitet njesi biznesi ne katin e pare me siperfaqe 60 m2, si mundesi mjaft e mire investimi duke marre parasysh qe aktualisht eshte e dhene me qira 500 euro/muaj (neto). Ambienti eshte openspace dhe eshte pjese e qendres tregtare Condor, nje qender multifunksionale me biznese, zyra dhe aktivitete te tjera tregtare. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Opportunity! Shop for sale at Condor Center, ideal opportunity for investment!!
description_en: At Rruga e Kavajes, at Condor Center, a business unit on the first floor with a surface area of ​​60 m2 is for sale, as a very good investment opportunity considering that it is currently rented for 500 euros/month (net). The environment is open space and is part of the Condor shopping center, a multifunctional center with businesses, offices and other commercial activities. Has regular mortgage documentation.
